records.title: From Pixels to Words - Towards Native One-Vision Models at Scale
records.reason: The architecture may reduce modality-interface overhead, but the primary text does not quantify deployed inference gains.

records.title: OpenSkillEval: Automatically Auditing the Open Skill Ecosystem for LLM Agents
records.reason: OpenSkillEval is an audit/benchmark of open agent skills and reports safety/quality auditing; its primary abstract does not present an inference-efficiency intervention.

records.title: HorizonStream: Long-Horizon Attention for Streaming 3D Reconstruction
records.reason: The primary text develops long-horizon attention for streaming 3D reconstruction and evaluates geometric reconstruction quality. Its attention mechanism is for 3D scene reconstruction, not LLM/VLM language inference or serving.

records.title: DySink: Dynamic Frame Sinks for Autoregressive Long Video Generation
records.reason: The efficiency mechanism is for video diffusion frame history, with no demonstrated LLM inference benefit.

records.title: A Survey of Large Audio Language Models: Generalization, Trustworthiness, and Outlook
records.reason: This is a survey of large audio language models focused on generalization and trustworthiness; it synthesizes the field rather than proposing a concrete inference-cost or serving method.
